QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_36

question.text: Under the SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) Amendment Regulations 2023, an AIF Manager is required to redress an investor grievance within:

answer.text: 21 calendar days from the date of receipt of the grievance

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) Amendment Regulations 2023, AIF Managers must redress investor grievances within 21 CALENDAR days from date of receipt. Complaints filed on SCORES are auto-forwarded to the AIF for ATR within the same TAT. **The Trap:** 7 days is too short. 60/90 days are older pre-2023 norms for other segments. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the 21-day TAT. III-A/C Compliance exams test SCORES mechanics in general. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Build a SCORES-ATR SOP: acknowledgement within 3 business days, resolution target within 15, final ATR upload within 21 calendar days. Missing TAT hurts your CTR score and can trigger SEBI enforcement.
